description: This Java source file defines the class UpdateThingResponse, which is a response message for acknowledging updates to 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, building payloads, and accessing update-related metadata.

classes.name: UpdateThingResponse
classes.description: A response message indicating the result of updating a thing, including revision number, policy info, and success status.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an UpdateThingResponse from individual parameters.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an UpdateThingResponse object from a JSON representation and headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the response payload into JSON, based on schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing this response pertains to.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing being responded about.

methods.name: getThingRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number for the thing.

methods.name: getPolicyId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID if available.

methods.name: getPolicyRevision
methods.description: Returns the policy revision if available.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Indicates whether the update was acknowledged as successful.
